# Vera Zhang

> Contemporary Chinese artist. Personal site featuring fine art paintings, bilingual writing on creativity.

Vera Zhang is a painter at heart. The site is bilingual (English and 中文); content is authored in both languages where applicable.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://www.verazhang.com/): The Love Story — a featured three-piece painting series (First Sight, In Love, The Wall).
- [About](https://www.verazhang.com/about): Bilingual bio written as a short poem.
- [Art](https://www.verazhang.com/art): Gallery of paintings.
- [Blog](https://www.verazhang.com/blog): Writing on art, emotion, and craft.
